gallery.title: Available integrations
gallery.hint: Integrations you can connect to this workspace, and the ways to build your own.
gallery.desc.connectors: Sync items and calendars with outside services such as GitHub and Google Calendar. Admins only.
gallery.desc.authorized: Apps you have given access to your account. Revoke any app to stop its access.
gallery.desc.api: Keys for scripts and tools that act as you. A key can never do more than you can.
gallery.desc.webhooks: Send item events to an HTTPS endpoint you control, with a delivery log.
gallery.desc.clients: Register apps that sign users in with OAuth. Admins only.
api.hint: API keys act as you: a key can never do more than you can, and a read key can only fetch data. Send it as Authorization: Bearer <key>.
api.name: Key name
api.revokeConfirm: Revoke this key? Anything using it stops working immediately.
api.secretHint: This is the only time the full key is shown.
gallery.providers.github.name: GitHub Issues
gallery.providers.github.desc: Sync GitHub issues with workspace tasks. Two-way sync.
gallery.providers.google.name: Google Calendar
gallery.providers.google.desc: Connect workspace schedules with your calendar. One-way sync.
gallery.builders.api.name: API keys
gallery.builders.api.desc: Access workspace data from scripts and tools.
gallery.builders.webhooks.name: Webhooks
gallery.builders.webhooks.desc: Receive event updates at an HTTPS endpoint.
gallery.builders.clients.name: OAuth apps
gallery.builders.clients.desc: Register an application that signs users in with OAuth.
api.createDescription: Choose a name, a scope and an optional expiry. The full key is shown once, right after it is created.
api.emptyDescription: Create a key for a script or tool that needs to act as you.
api.storeNote: API keys inherit the account permissions that apply to you. Store them securely and never paste them into chats or screenshots.
gallery.providers.pydio.name: Pydio Cells
gallery.providers.pydio.desc: Link Pydio document folders to projects. PMS stores only the link.
pydio.description: Choose which Pydio folders can be linked to projects. Files still open in Pydio with the person's own access.
pydio.sourceHint.database: These settings replace the server environment as a whole.
pydio.sourceHint.environment: Saving replaces the server environment as a whole.
pydio.sourceHint.none: Fill in the form and save to turn links on.
pydio.listingHint: Only the server operator can change file listing.
pydio.rootsHint: One per line: a workspace slug, optionally with subfolders, such as projects or common-files/Clients. Existing references outside the list show as invalid.
pydio.customersHint: A project shows a document link only for a Customer listed here. Every folder must be inside an allowed folder.
pydio.uploadsHint: These limits apply to Pydio storage once uploading to it is available. PMS cannot upload to Pydio yet, and local attachments are not affected.
pydio.typesHint: File extensions separated by commas, spaces or lines, at most 100. Leave empty to allow every file type. Only the file name is checked.
pydio.saveFailed: The Pydio settings could not be saved.
pydio.removeDescription: The server environment applies again and the upload limits return to 100 MB and every file type. If the environment has no Pydio values, links turn off.
